title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-mjcp: receiver_abort not imported in fragmentation.rs test
description:
## Issue

`rust/lichen-schc/tests/fragmentation.rs:174` calls `receiver_abort(0x78).write_to(&mut abort).unwrap()` but does not import `receiver_abort` in the use statement (line 6-9).

The function `receiver_abort` IS publicly exported from `lichen_schc::fragment` (declared `pub const fn` at fragment.rs:340).

## Fix

Add `receiver_abort` to the import:
```rust
use lichen_schc::fragment::{
    Ack, Fragment, FragmentReceiver, FragmentSender, receiver_abort, ReceiverResponse, SenderOutput,
    SenderStatus, TILE_SIZE,
};
```
